INV-007 viewer read-only capability and access-management refusal tests

Exact point within an operation when the clock is read
dispositions.reason: Where in an operation its one wall reading is taken is not observable: CLK-001 makes that one instant every current time the operation uses and every event timestamp it writes, a refused operation writes nothing, and the read point changes no answer at the precision of a session or credential lifetime. The notes of each operation say it reads utc_now once and reuses the instant; the test of CLK-001 fixes the clock source at one instant.
